## Jack Hammer (Drill Bit)

Jack Hammer is the tan, stubbly construction stallion seen around Cloudsdale and Ponyville in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. He appears as a Pegasus in his debut, then as an Earth pony in later episodes; that model change is **not** a documented transformation or disguise. Look for his dark two-tone mane, blue eyes, and screwdriver-and-two-screws cutie mark. Police-officer appearances swap in a badge and sometimes omit his stubble.

**Names and voice.** He is unnamed in television dialogue. Enterplay's 2013 Gen Con demo card calls him **Jack Hammer**, while later *Premiere* cards and Gameloft's game use **Drill Bit**—licensed-media names, not names established in the show. He speaks once recognizably, shouting “Look!” during a rescue; no individual English voice actor was reliably verified. Sources: [character record](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Jack_Hammer) and [collectible-card catalog](https://data.mlpmerch.com/ccg/card/).

**Appearances.** *Sonic Rainboom* (S1E16, Cloudsdale worker); *The Mysterious Mare Do Well* (S2E8, building-site rescue); *Pinkie Pride* (S4E12, worker/officer variants); *Made in Manehattan* (S5E16, officer); *Fluttershy Leans In* and *Honest Apple* (S7E5/E9, construction); *Between Dark and Dawn* (S9E13, royal carpenter). Also catalogued in IDW's *Ponyville Mysteries* #5.

## Important moments

- **A warning amid falling debris** — *The Mysterious Mare Do Well* (S2E8). Jack Hammer shouts “Look!” during the collapsing-site rescue, where Mare Do Well saves the workers and upstages Rainbow Dash. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lZMf0sB5Hnk) (scene timestamp unavailable).
- **The sanctuary plan ignored** — *Fluttershy Leans In* (S7E5). Jack Hammer is part of Hard Hat's crew as their boss disregards Fluttershy's instructions; her rejection of the misguided construction plan marks a turning point in her assertiveness. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nrVhWV2Rs2Y) (scene timestamp unavailable).
